capabilities: Add or remove tags in bulk from the right-click menu on selected notes
Tag all notes matching a search result
Toggle starred tags via commands, status bar buttons, and context-menu entries
Insert tags into note metadata through a tag selector GUI
Add new tags from the tag selector
extras: The README warns there is no undo/redo queue, so bulk tagging or removing all tags cannot be reverted; it is provided as-is without guarantee for every situation.
intentEvidence: adds commands and a GUI to select tags to put in note metadata
motivation: The author originally developed it to improve their personal workflow.
problem: Obsidian's core tag handling makes adding or removing tags across multiple selected notes or search results slow and manual.

relations.evidence: it's very handy in conjunction with Obsidian Commander
QuickAdd for examples of how to add and remove commands

summary: Tag tool that adds commands, context-menu actions, ribbon and status bar buttons to add, remove, and bulk-apply tags to notes.
